notices.title: Test of Alert Ready emergency messaging system planned for November 18
notices.summary: Test of Alert Ready emergency messaging system planned for November 18 zaburke November 12, 2026 - 4:09 pm On Wednesday, November 18, the Yukon will be participating in a national test of the Alert Ready system at approximately 1:55 pm local time. Alert Ready is Canada's emergency alerting system that delivers critical and potentially life-saving alerts to Canadians. The Alert Ready test will be broadcast on cellphones, radio stations and televisions across the territory. The test alert will clearly state that it is a TEST.
